title: ERPL GC-4 Stand Configuration
description: Defines every actuator, sensor, controller, autosequence and P&ID symbol for a test stand. The UI is generated entirely from this file.

meta.description: Identifying information shown in the header and recorded in CSV sidecars.

standLogo.description: Stand badge shown in the header. Both variants should be silhouettes on transparency.

light.description: Image used in the light theme.

dark.description: Image used in the dark theme.

logo.description: Organization wordmark in the header, swapped per theme.

accent.description: Accent colour; text colour on it is chosen automatically.

defaultTheme.description: Used only until an operator picks a theme on this machine.

pages.description: Header navigation. Remove an entry to hide that page.

tankLevel.description: P&ID tank fill level estimated from the hydrostatic head between a tank-bottom PT and the ullage PT. Display only.

enabled.description: Show the computed level on the P&ID. When false, tank fills fall back to levelSensor.

heightIn.description: Height of the propellant tanks in inches; a full tank. Levels are clamped to it.

smoothingSeconds.description: Time constant of the exponential filter on the level, in seconds. The level is a small difference between two large pressures, so it needs heavy smoothing to be readable; 0 disables it.

requireShiftToActuate.description: Require SHIFT to be held for any click that moves the stand away from safe (open a valve, enable a controller, start a sequence). Default true. A slip guard in the browser only — the server interlocks are unaffected either way.

sampleRateHz.description: Control loop rate. Interlocks and bang-bang run at this rate.

historySeconds.description: Server-side history so a browser joining mid-test still sees trends.

requireArmToActuate.description: Master switch for the ARM interlock.

autoDisarmAfterSeconds.description: 0 disables. Never fires while a sequence is running.

abortSequenceId.description: Sequence run on ABORT. If absent, abortState is applied directly.

valveGroups.description: Sections on the Control Grid page, in display order.

sensorGroups.description: Sensor sections, in display order. Each becomes a column on the Data page and colours its members there and on the P&ID.

color.description: Outline on the Data page and bubble colour on the P&ID.

valves.description: Every commandable output: solenoids, pneumatic valves, igniters.

id.description: Tag used everywhere. Must be unique.

channel.description: Hardware output channel. Must be unique across valves.

normallyOpen.description: True if the valve flows with the coil de-energized. The driver inverts energization for these.

requiresArm.description: If true, cannot be opened while DISARMED.

confirm.description: Ignored. Valve commands are never confirmed — ARM is the gate.

safeState.description: Commands toward this state are ALWAYS permitted, even disarmed or in abort.

pid.description: Placement on the schematic. Omit to leave the valve off the P&ID.

rot.description: 0 for a horizontal run, 90 for a vertical run.

tag.description: Tag stencilled on the hardware (S1, PB2...), drawn above the symbol so a valve on screen can be matched to one on the stand.

sensors.description: Every input channel: pressure transducers, thermocouples, load cells.

kind.description: Groups the sensor on the Data page.

group.description: A sensorGroups id. Defaults to `kind`, so an unset group still sorts sensors by type.

channel.description: Hardware input channel. Must be unique across sensors.

min.description: Display range floor (bar graphs, P&ID band).

calibration.description: engineering = raw * slope + offset. Applied by the udp/serial drivers.

lead.description: [x, y] of the process tap. A dashed lead is drawn from the bubble to here.

bangbang.description: Bang-bang pressure regulators. THE LOOP RUNS ON THE PANDA BOARD, against the board's own PT channels — see HANDOVER_COMMS.md section 5. Ground control pushes these values, asks the board to start and stop, and supervises; it never drives the valve itself.

sensor.description: Must be a defined sensor id. DISPLAY AND SUPERVISION ONLY — the board regulates on its OWN transducer, not this one. They are two different sensors on the same tank and may disagree.

valve.description: Must be a defined valve id. The press solenoid the BOARD drives. Listed here so the UI can label it and so the server can refuse manual commands to a valve the board's loop owns; the server never actuates it.

deadband.description: Half-band, in sensor units: the board opens below setpoint-deadband and closes above setpoint+deadband. Sent to the board as the FULL band width (2x this). Starting value only: adjustable from the actuation screens while armed.

enabled.description: Initial state at server start. Nothing is enabled on the board until a config echo confirms the setpoint.

requiresArm.description: HOST SUPERVISORY. Controller is told to stop when the stand disarms. Not runtime-adjustable.

maxOpenSeconds.description: HOST SUPERVISORY, no board equivalent. The board's press bit reported open longer than this tells the board to stop and raises a fault - catches leaks and dead transducers. 0 disables. Starting value only: adjustable from the actuation screens while armed.

maxOpenMs.description: BOARD-SIDE, sent as max_open_ms. One actuation holds the press valve open at most this long. Must be less than maxOpenSeconds. 0 disables. Starting value only: adjustable from the actuation screens while armed.

minIntervalMs.description: BOARD-SIDE, sent as wait_ms. The board's minimum dwell between valve state transitions. NOTE: GC-4's own limit never delayed a CLOSE; the board's wait_ms is documented as a dwell between any transitions and may. Verify against firmware. 0 disables. Starting value only: adjustable from the actuation screens while armed.

abortAbove.description: HOST SUPERVISORY, no board equivalent. Either the board's PT or this controller's sensor above this latches a stand-wide ABORT and sends a per-side abort. Omit for no threshold. Starting value only: adjustable from the actuation screens while armed.

side.description: Which board bus this controller is. 'L' (LOX) and 'F' (Fuel) are the letters the board's B/V/M/b/v/x commands take. Required: without it the controller cannot be pushed to the board.

ventValve.description: Optional. The vent solenoid this side's board loop drives, as a defined valve id. Used to mirror the board's vent bit onto the P&ID and to refuse manual commands while the loop owns it.

ventTrigger.description: BOARD-SIDE, sent as the V command's trigger. Pressure at which the board's auto-vent engages (the AV state). Omit for no vent config.

ventAuto.description: BOARD-SIDE. Arms the board's automatic venting at ventTrigger. Requires ventTrigger.

predictive.description: BOARD-SIDE. Predictive valve shutoff (e<side><0|1>): the board closes the press valve on the predicted overshoot rather than on the band edge. Enabling it requires the stand ARMED, so a true here is the power-on preference, not a guarantee — it is pushed when the operator toggles it, never re-asserted silently.

autosequences.description: Time-based scripts. Steps fire when elapsed >= t, in order.

description.description: Shown on hover and in the confirmation dialog.

hidden.description: Hide from the sidebar (used for the abort sequence).

timeMode.description: How the editor presents step times. Steps are always STORED as absolute t; 'relative' only changes how you type them in (as the gap from the previous step).

abortConditions.description: Evaluated every tick while the sequence runs. Any trip aborts the stand.

action.description: valve: set a valve. bangbang: change a controller ('*' for all). safeAll/abortStates: drive every actuator. log: note in the event log and CSV.

rateHz.description: CSV row rate; decimated from the control loop.

derived.description: Extra CSV columns computed from other channels. Recording only — these are not sensors and do not appear in the UI.

header.description: Column name, without the units suffix.

sum.description: Sensor ids added together. A row where any of them is missing is left blank rather than partially summed.

pid.description: The schematic. Coordinates are SVG user units in a width x height canvas.

fluids.description: Named services. Each pipe references one by key.

components.description: Static symbols: vessels, fittings, structure, free text.

fluid.description: tank: colour of the liquid fill.

levelSensor.description: tank: sensor id driving the liquid level.

levelMax.description: tank: sensor value corresponding to a full tank.

plumeSensor.description: engine: sensor id driving exhaust plume intensity.

srcDark.description: logo only: image URL used in the dark theme.

level.description: tank: differential-pressure level estimate. h[in] = 1728 * (bottom - top)[psi] / density[lb/ft^3], clamped to ui.tankLevel.heightIn.

bottomSensor.description: Sensor id reading pressure at the tank bottom (liquid head + ullage).

topSensor.description: Sensor id reading ullage pressure. Mutually exclusive with topController.

topController.description: Bang-bang controller id whose BOARD transducer reads ullage pressure — used when the ullage PT is on the panda board rather than the DAQ. Ignored while the heartbeat is stale.

density.description: Propellant density in lb/ft^3 at expected conditions (LOX ~71.2, IPA ~49.1).

pipes.description: Process lines as polylines. Shared endpoints are auto-marked as tees.

flowWhen.description: Valve ids that must ALL be open for the flow animation to run.
